facts.fact: L'Express reports the DGI training Antsiranana commune staff in setting up addressing and tax census operations, with drones to be used before building the database.

MDG.note: Nothing on connection of local government offices.

facts.fact: L'Express reports that the PIC project funds the G-IFPB property-tax software to be used by Antsiranana commune and the DGI centre once addressing and census data are collected, and the training of commune staff.

MDG.note: Nothing on discussion, cuts or punishment.
